events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, defining a generation.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace. What's your favourite track that defined Woodstock?

events.title: Elvis Presley: King of Rock 'n' Roll
events.blurb: Remembering Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977, leaving an unparalleled legacy.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music still reigns supreme. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, the influential hip-hop artist Tupac Shakur passed away.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years since we lost a legend. Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture is still felt today. Which of his tracks still resonates most with you?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Guitar Legend
events.blurb: Remembering the revolutionary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Hendrix Forever
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the man who redefined guitar. Jimi Hendrix's legacy burns bright. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... still flawless. What's your favourite side?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style are truly iconic. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the iconic Oasis and solo artist, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as relevant as ever. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond's Best
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, which 007 film or song is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message still resonate deeply. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'. So diverse, so groundbreaking. What's your hidden gem from this masterpiece?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: A Legend Remembered
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
